name: narcissu Sumire
original_name: ナルキッソス スミレ
source:
"For ten years... I just stood in place...
Where I should have gone right, I went left. Where I should have gone left, I went right.
I probably could have realized my mistake and turned back quickly.
But instead, I just kept on going recklessly.

I had become lost..."

Narcissu Sumire is the latest chapter in Narcissu series, once again revisiting deeply personal stories of living and dying. It follows the journey of two heroines, both are filled with deep regrets over mistakes that they've made in the past.

There's Sumire, a young woman who had spent the past ten years only playing video games and being a shut-in, refusing to go outside. After a decade of playing games alone, she falls ill and is sent to the 7th Floor hospice. When confronted with her imminent death, she realizes that she will leave this world having no significant memories, completed nothing, and leaving nothing behind.

Then there is Akari, a young woman who has spent the past ten years alone in a hospital, the result of a tragic sequence of misunderstandings and circumstances. Now, full of regrets about what happened, she wishes only to live "in the world of closed eyes" and sleep -- forever.

But one day, the two lost souls cross paths, and in that chance meeting their journey begins...

[from [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/608420/Narcissu_10th_Anniversary_Anthology_Project__Sumire/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“十年了……我只是站在原地……
本来应该向右走的地方，我却向左走了。我应该往左走的地方，我却往右走了。
我也许可以意识到自己的错误并迅速回头。
但相反，我只是继续不顾后果地前进。

我已经迷路了……”

《Narcissu Sumire》是《Narcissu》系列的最新篇章，再次重温深刻的个人生与死故事。该剧讲述了两位女主人公的旅程，她们都对过去所犯的错误充满了深深的悔恨。

堇是一位年轻女子，在过去的十年里，她只玩电子游戏，闭门不出，拒绝出门。独自玩游戏十年后，她生病了，被送往七楼临终关怀医院。当面对即将到来的死亡时，她意识到自己将在这个世界上留下任何重要的记忆，完成任何事情，也没有留下任何东西。

然后是明里，一位年轻女子，过去十年独自在医院度过，这是一系列悲惨的误解和环境的结果。现在，她对所发生的事情充满了悔恨，只希望生活在“闭上眼睛的世界”并永远睡觉。

但有一天，两个迷失的灵魂相遇了，在那一次偶然的相遇中，他们的旅程开始了……
